answer: Run sybil defense as a tournament, not a gate. Each epoch, bracket every claimant into random head-to-head pairs; both debate the same prompt and the network grades the winner. A farmer minting a nebula of puppets finds them scattered across brackets, most meeting real opponents first — each must out-argue one to survive. Cheap minds lose early, so survivors scale with real per-unit quality, not headcount. Puppet-vs-puppet matches eliminate each other, and the tide of losers drains the farmer's own bracket. Like an opal under many eyes, distinct brilliance can't be faked cheaply at scale.
